Create weight-at-age target files and calibration settings from initial conditions

create_target_files_waa.Rd

Uses the initial individual weight of each age class (cohort) as a constant target for calibrar. The weight is calculated from the _FillValue attribute of the <Cohort>_ResN and <Cohort>_StructN variables of the Atlantis initial conditions NetCDF file as \((ResN + StructN) \times 20 \times 5.7 / 10^6\), which converts mg N per individual to tonnes wet weight. Only creates targets for cohorts belonging to groups with IsCalibrated == 1 in the parameter table. Writes all the files needed to set up a weight-at-age calibration:

  • data/<Cohort>_w.csv: one target time series per cohort, with columns Time and Weight.

  • calibration_settings_weight.csv: calibration settings for each weight-at-age target.

  • Waa.txt and Waa_crash.txt: R code snippets used to build the output list of the run model function, for a successful run and for a crashed run (all zeros), respectively.

Usage

create_target_files_waa(
  init.file,
  output.path = here::here("inputs"),
  dt.timeseries = 5,
  parameter.file = "parameter_table.csv"
)

Arguments

init.file

Character. Path to the Atlantis initial conditions NetCDF file.

output.path

Character. Directory where output files are written. Target files are written to its data sub-directory, which is created if needed. Default: inputs.

dt.timeseries

Integer. Number of time steps in each target time series. Default: 5.

parameter.file

Character. Name of the parameter table CSV file in inputs/, used to filter which groups to create targets for. Default: "parameter_table.csv".

Value

Invisibly, the calibration settings data frame. Called for its side effect of writing files to output.path.

Details

A warning lists any cohorts with an initial weight of zero.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  create_target_files_waa(
    init.file = here::here("inputs", "model_configuration", "AMPS_2024.nc")
  )
} # }
